content.text: {"headline":"Approve P2 (callback on both queues plus 20% chat deflection on payments, ₹60), but call the duty manager: even this plan only reaches 40.6% against the 80% target for 19:45-20:00.","why":"The gap is dengue-related sickness, not extra calls. 11 sick absences are logged on each queue against a usual 2.6 and 2.4, and volume is near or below forecast. With no action, service level is predicted at 28.8% with 30.0% abandons. P2 is the best of the options: 40.6% overall (payments 24.4%, general 70.8%), with abandons cut to 20.3%, for ₹60. R1 gives identical predictions at the same cost. Escalation is flagged because the best compliant plan is still below the 70% escalation line (ESC-02). The duty manager needs to decide whether anything beyond these levers, such as extra staff, is possible for the final interval.","trade_offs":["P1 costs nothing but only reaches 32.9% and leaves abandons at 27.6%.","P3 and R2 cost more (₹84) and do worse (36.2%). Adding deflection on general lifts payments slightly to 25.5% but drops general from 70.8% to 59.1%.","P2 favours general: payments stays very weak at 24.4%, slightly below P1's 25.0%, so payments customers bear most of the remaining impact."],"watch":"Watch payments service level and abandons through 19:45-20:00, and check that callbacks and chat deflection are actually taking calls off the queue. If general drops well below 70.8%, re-check with the duty manager."}
